description: 35 self-authored fictional two-document bridge questions over 11 domain labels. A small controlled regression/teaching corpus; not a diverse real-world benchmark, not human calibrated, and not a claim of broad research quality.
provenance: Created for this project's M8 educational evaluation. Every entity assignment and rule is invented. Documents use the reserved benchmark.invalid domain and must never be downloaded. Gold was authored with the fixtures, has not been independently annotated, and must not enter generation prompts. Shared templates make cases correlated; domain labels do not create independent domain coverage.

cases.question: In this fictional scenario, what release channel applies to Atlas deployment? Explain the connection between the two documents.

documents.title: Atlas deployment assignment
documents.text:
Fictional benchmark record. Atlas deployment is assigned to the Orion build policy.
This record identifies the applicable policy but does not state its release channel.

documents.title: Orion build policy specification
documents.text:
Fictional benchmark rule. The Orion build policy specifies release channel: canary.
The rule applies to every item assigned to this named policy.

facts.statement: Atlas deployment is assigned to the Orion build policy.
The Orion build policy specifies release channel: canary.
